1.w: Praise the Lord! How blessed is the one who obeys the Lord, who takes great delight in keeping his commands.

2.w: His descendants will be powerful on the earth; the godly will be blessed.

3.w: His house contains wealth and riches; his integrity endures.

4.w: In the darkness a light shines for the godly, for each one who is merciful, compassionate, and just.

5.w: It goes well for the one who generously lends money and conducts his business honestly.

6.w: For he will never be shaken; others will always remember one who is just.

7.w: He does not fear bad news. He is confident; he trusts in the Lord.

8.w: His resolve is firm; he will not succumb to fear before he looks in triumph on his enemies.

9.w: He generously gives to the needy; his integrity endures. He will be vindicated and honored.

10.w: When the wicked see this, they will worry; they will grind their teeth in frustration and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
